bit_string_types.description: IGMP version; this memo specifies version 1

bit_string_types.description: IGMP message type: 1 = Host Membership Query, 2 = Host Membership Report

bit_string_types.name: unused
bit_string_types.description: Unused field, zeroed when sent, ignored when received

bit_string_types.description: 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the 8-octet IGMP message

bit_string_types.name: group_address

helper_functions.name: compute_checksum
helper_functions.description: Computes the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the 8-octet IGMP message, with the checksum field zeroed.

transform_functions.name: ip_to_ethernet_multicast_address
transform_functions.description: Map an IP host group address to an Ethernet multicast address by placing the low-order 23 bits of the IP address into the low-order 23 bits of the Ethernet multicast address 01-00-5E-00-00-00 (hex).
